Overview

Problem and role

Create a more scalable, modular system for collecting useful job-seeker stories while balancing limited research and content design capacity.

My role

Lead designer

Duration

4 quarters

Responsibilities

End-to-end process

Constraints

Limited content design and UX research resources

Highlights

Outcomes at a glance

Increase in content collection 5%
New design components 20+
Experiments shipped 10+

Process

How the work unfolded

Chapter 1

Discovery

Beginner’s mindsetCompetitive analysisEvaluative research

The first step was understanding where content lived today, what motivated contribution, and where the experience lost momentum or trust.

Chapter 2

Ideation

WorkshopDesign explorations

Workshops were used to broaden the solution space and align cross-functional partners around where better prompts, structure, and modularity could unlock more contributions.

Chapter 3

Hi-fi design

Modular patterns

The design system direction focused on repeatable collection patterns that could be reused across multiple contribution moments without reinventing the flow each time.

Chapter 4

Roadmap

Prioritization workshop

Prioritization combined effort and impact to decide which experiments were worth pursuing first, helping the team sequence opportunities rationally.

Chapter 5

UX strategy

Long-term planWhat and where

The long-term strategy clarified where content should appear, what types of contribution mattered most, and how the system could keep scaling over time.

Chapter 6

Modular design system

Component library

The end result was not just a one-off flow, but a composable collection toolkit that teams could extend into future experiments.
